items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: He used to live right close to Lewis the Man, right in the back of Lewis the Man.

ctx.x: He didn't know what part of town, or if he was born here in town, did you ever hear him
say anything about his life? Well I think he was born here in town because the head trumpet player used to be in the band, used to teach for y'all. Lewis the Man.
